name: Language (modalselect)
xml:
<field
	type="ModalSelect"
	name="language"
	label="Language"
	sql_title_table="#__###component###_language"
	sql_title_column="name"
	sql_title_key="langtag"
	urlSelect="index.php?option=com_###component###&view=languages&layout=modal&tmpl=component&titleKey=langtag"
	urlNew="index.php?option=com_###component###&task=language.add&layout=modal&tmpl=component"
	urlEdit="index.php?option=com_###component###&task=language.edit&langtag={id}&layout=modal&tmpl=component&titleKey=langtag"
	titleSelect="Select a Language"
	titleNew="New Language"
	titleEdit="Edit Language"
	iconSelect="icon-copy"
	select="true"
	new="true"
	edit="true"
	clear="true"
	required="true"
	class="input-large"
	hint="Select a Language"
	default="en-GB"
/>
